ImageDescription.value: Photo of Kurt Russell as Phil Girard, Jr. and David Janssen as Richard Kimble from the television program The Fugitive. In this episode, "Nemesis", Girard and his son are vacationing when he gets a report that Kimble is in the area. Girard then contacts the local sheriff. Kimble manages to escape from them both by stealing the sheriff's car, but is at first unaware that he's also kidnapped Girard's son, who was in the car's back seat.
